explanation: Cooks in Bologna say the thick sauce clings better to flat egg ribbons than to thin spaghetti. The same ragù is layered into the city's green lasagne.

claims.text: In Bologna, ragù alla bolognese is traditionally served with tagliatelle.
Spaghetti, penne and fusilli are not the traditional pasta for ragù alla bolognese in Bologna.
Tagliatelle are flat ribbons of egg pasta.
Bolognese cooks favour tagliatelle because the thick ragù clings to flat ribbons better than to spaghetti.
Ragù alla bolognese is also layered in green (spinach) lasagne alla bolognese.
